Le modèle et les accords automatiques ne: The model and the automatic approvals are never taken over. Lutin's current state is kept in a zip before the import.
Pour que Lutin ne ralentisse pas le rest: So that Lutin does not slow down the rest of the computer while you work. Leave empty = automatic. The model reloads once when you change the cores.
Applique des valeurs toutes faites : Dis: Applies ready-made values: Quiet = half of the cores, model kept 2 minutes, smaller context; Normal = everything automatic; Maximum = all the cores, model kept 30 minutes.
Nombre de cœurs du processeur que le mod: Number of processor cores the model may use. Fewer cores = slower, but the rest of the computer stays responsive. Mostly useful when the model runs on the processor.
Combien de minutes le modèle reste en mé: How many minutes the model stays in memory after the last answer. 0 = released right away (the memory goes back to the PC, but the next answer is slower to start). Empty = automatic.
